title: mkreyman/chg and mkreyman/loopctl-runner are archived, and their loopctl records move to the loopctl project

story.i_want_to: retire the two old repositories in the same release that moved their code, with their open issues, intake sources and projects folded into loopctl's
story.so_that: there is never a second place to change the runner or chg, and nothing waits on a repository nobody watches

rationale: PRD section 4: refactor, never build beside; R10: the old repos are archived in the release that moves them. After US-52.4 to US-52.10 the code, CI, releases and installs all come from mkreyman/loopctl, but loopctl still holds live records for the old repos: intake source 7c2ca807 (mkreyman/chg, mode pr, project b5343742) and 23775166 (mkreyman/loopctl-runner, mode ledger, project 9ef476b0) keep polling archived repos, those projects hold stories and channel posts apart from loopctl's project a40edb79, and open issues on the old repos would never be seen again. Each machine's ~/.chg/loopctl.toml also still names [[source]] blocks for the old repos.

acceptance_criteria.description: release/retire-repo.sh <owner/name> refuses (exit 2, naming each blocker) while the repo has an open pull request or a story of its loopctl project sits between claimed and merged; otherwise it transfers every open issue to mkreyman/loopctl with gh issue transfer, adding the label from:<name>, then archives the repo with gh repo archive --yes.

retire-repo.sh is idempotent: on an already archived repo with no open issue it makes no GitHub write and prints 'retired: <owner/name>'; an issue whose transfer failed is retried on the next run, and the repo is not archived until no open issue remains.

After archiving, retire-repo.sh runs release/import-history.sh for that repo a last time, so release/imports.toml's imported_sha equals the archived repo's master tip, and records archived = true on that [[import]] entry; import-history.sh refuses to import an entry marked archived.

release/manifest.toml lists [retired] repos = ["mkreyman/chg", "mkreyman/loopctl-runner"], and install-machine.sh (US-52.10) first sends any pending outbox rows for a retired repo with chg outbox send, then removes that repo's [[source]] blocks from ~/.chg/loopctl.toml, leaving every other block byte-identical; a run with none left changes nothing.

After the epic merges and the rollout is green, the session revokes intake sources 7c2ca807 and 23775166 (intake_source_revoke) and merges projects b5343742 and 9ef476b0 into a40edb79 with merge_project (provided by US-52.2), each first with dry_run: true; a merge_conflicts answer is resolved by renumbering the source's conflicting rows and run again, never by skipping the merge.

No tracked file in mkreyman/loopctl names mkreyman/chg, mkreyman/loopctl-runner or a ~/workspace/chg or ~/workspace/loopctl-runner path, except the files the root test's own allowlist names, each because it carries the migration: release/imports.toml, release/manifest.toml (its [retired] list, AC-52.11.4), release/install-machine.sh (AC-52.10.3, AC-52.11.4), release/retire-repo.sh, chg/bin/chg-loop.py (its old-path routing, AC-52.5.7), CHANGELOG.md, docs/factory/, docs/user_stories/ and the test file itself; test/ and mcp-server/test/ are outside the scan, because their fixtures use the name as sample data and point nobody at the repo; and a match followed at once by #<digits> (an issue citation, still readable on the archived repo) is not an offence. The test lists each offending file and line outside that allowlist.

test_cases.name: retire refuses with blockers, then transfers and archives, then is a no-op (ExUnit, shell under test)
preconditions: a gh stub answering from a scripted repo state and recording writes; a loopctl stub answering the project's story list
steps: state: no PR, two open issues, the first transfer failing; run
expected_results: exit 2 naming the PR; one transfer, no archive; second transfer and archive; no write and 'retired: ...'

test_cases.name: an in-flight story blocks retirement
preconditions: loopctl stub returning a story at implementing for the repo's project
expected_results: exit 2 naming the story id and status; no GitHub write

test_cases.name: final import and the archived marker (shell under test)
preconditions: the US-52.4 test's temp source and target
steps: add a commit to the source, mark it archived via retire-repo.sh's final step
expected_results: imported_sha is the new tip and archived = true; the second import exits 2 naming the archived entry

test_cases.name: loopctl.toml cleanup keeps other sources (shell under test)
preconditions: a temp HOME with ~/.chg/loopctl.toml holding [[source]] for mkreyman/chg, mkreyman/loopctl and mkreyman/home_care_billing; a chg stub recording outbox send
expected_results: chg outbox send called first; the mkreyman/chg block gone, the other two byte-identical; the second run changes nothing

test_cases.name: no stale reference to the old repos (root ExUnit)
steps: scan every tracked text file outside the allowed paths, test/ and mcp-server/test/ for the four patterns
scan a temp tree holding one line 'see mkreyman/chg#33' and one line 'clone mkreyman/chg'
expected_results: no match; a failure lists file:line
only the second line is reported

test_cases.name: the post-merge record (session, MCP)
expected_results: neither old source is active; b5343742 and 9ef476b0 are archived with metadata.merged_into a40edb79

technical_notes: Old repos' loopctl records (intake_source_list, 2026-11-19): mkreyman/chg source 7c2ca807-f66d-4db4-944c-24fbf3545ff0, project b5343742-3dd4-4a9e-b421-baee42696f3e, mode pr; mkreyman/loopctl-runner source 23775166-c02c-459a-a9fe-5b729110d656, project 9ef476b0-4e51-423d-8941-34267652d496, mode ledger; loopctl source 0265e194-9a65-4e0d-bed3-6f82c2e22d69, project a40edb79-d290-475f-9bdb-6e6c5458af97. Merge: POST /api/v1/projects/:id/merge_into and Loopctl.Projects.Merge.merge_into/4 (provided by US-52.2), human-anchored, so the session runs it with Mark's user key from where earlier sessions keep it.

Order: US-52.10's infra PR merges and the rollout runs from the epic branch's set first; then retire-repo.sh runs for both repos before the epic PR merges (an archived repo cannot take the final sync PR, and the final import must land in the epic); then the epic merges; then the revokes and project merges (AC-52.11.5).
Stories between claimed and merged: list_stories for the repo's project filtered by status (claimed, implementing, reported, review), the statuses the loop uses before merge.

chg's [[source]] config: ~/.chg/loopctl.toml, blocks of repo, source_id, secret_file (chg cli/src/config.rs). The edit is done by a python3 -I tomllib reader that rewrites only the matching blocks' line ranges, so comments and other blocks are untouched. chg outbox send drains pending rows first so no ledger row is lost.

Stale references to remove (AC-52.11.6): lib/loopctl/api_spec/runner_contract.ex (:11, :4729) and lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.runner_contract.ex:6 prose (already changed in US-52.4, AC-52.4.6), findings.ex:88 with its deploy/FLY_SECRETS.md:197 CHG_FINDINGS_REPO default and the config/runtime.exs:164 comment (US-52.5), the runner's README and CLAUDE.md clone instructions, chg's README install lines; and in this story: lib/loopctl_web/runner_channel.ex:749 (it says the runner lives in mkreyman/loopctl-runner; it now lives in this repo's runner/), .chg/adapter.toml:1, .githooks/pre-push:3, docs/agent-delivery-loop.md:173 and docs/measurements/README.md:3 (git grep -E 'mkreyman/chg|mkreyman/loopctl-runner|workspace/chg|workspace/loopctl-runner' outside the allowlist, test/ and mcp-server/test/, 2026-11-19). lib/loopctl/changes/envelope.ex:3 cites mkreyman/chg#33, an issue citation the test accepts. The test is test/loopctl/no_retired_repo_refs_test.exs.
Transferred issues carry their chg-loop marker comments, so chg-loop.py (now routing to mkreyman/loopctl, US-52.5) finds them again instead of filing duplicates.
No new table, context, route or tool: the merge, revoke and transfer are existing operations.
non_goals: Deleting the old repositories: archived repos stay readable.
Making mkreyman/loopctl private and authenticating installers: release 11 (US-52.66, PRD R12).
Moving claude-config or infra into this repo: later releases.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.11.2: a GitHub call lost midway leaves the remaining issues open and the repo unarchived; the next run continues from what is still open.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.11.3: which old repos are retired is recorded twice in git, release/imports.toml (archived = true) and release/manifest.toml [retired], read by the installer on each machine.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.11.2 and AC-52.11.4: every step checks before it writes, so a re-run on a retired repo or a cleaned machine writes nothing; merge_project's repeat answers already_merged (US-52.2).
failure_modes.slow: n/a: each step is one bounded gh or MCP call per issue or record; nothing waits on another system's progress.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.11.4: each machine removes its own old sources during its own install-machine.sh run, reached through US-52.10's rollout.

defaults: Transferred issues get the label from:<repo name> (owner may drop it).
Conflicting story numbers in a project merge are resolved by renumbering the old project's stories under a new epic number.
definition_of_done: gh repo view mkreyman/chg --json isArchived and the same for mkreyman/loopctl-runner both print true.
intake_source_list shows no active source for either old repo, and list_projects shows both old projects archived with merged_into a40edb79.
